summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and nothing is committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatter entry producing ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod, which passes the title as one two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) after show_cursor; it gates only on is_terminal, buffers a title control, and returns True, or returns False with nothing buffered. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that reads the title from the second item and calls term.set_title(title) once per control. CHANGELOG.md gains an Added section under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (output assertion skipped on legacy Windows, return value always checked), test_control.py::test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title. Choices: method placed after show_cursor; the Console test skips only the output assertion on legacy consoles. Tests were not run.
